name: Kaneohe
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Kaneohe, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Kaneohe, Hawaii for 2026: 3 family events, 2 free, with dates checked on host sites.
lede: Kaneohe keeps Christmas with local parades, Santa visits and community events.
celebrates: Kaneohe's Christmas centers on its parade. The Kaneohe Christmas Parade calls itself the largest community-run parade in Hawaii and draws about 10,000 spectators, according to the parade's own website, with a route from Windward Mall and Kaneohe Bay Shopping Center to Castle High School. Windward Mall adds Santa photos and a Santa arrival day in Center Court, and Kaneohe Public Library holds a free Santa Claus Story Time. The Windward side also has Papahana Kuaola's Keiki Kalikimaka, though its registration is closed.
lastyear: The parade website's 2026 homepage still shows the artwork from its 2025 edition, labeled Hometown Heroes 2025, above this year's He Mea Ono Kalikimaka theme. Windward Mall's Santa's Grand Arrival took place on Saturday, November 21, 2026, from 11 am to 1 pm in Center Court, with a holiday storybook show and face painting for the first 200 keiki, according to the mall's Santa page.
facts: The Kaneohe Christmas Parade lists more than 2,400 participants this year and sells a commemorative shirt at the Kaneohe branches of Central Pacific Bank and American Savings Bank and at the Aloha Diaper Bank, with proceeds funding the parade. Kaneohe Public Library opened in its present location in January 1963 and serves as the back-up reference library for the Windward branches in Kahuku, Kailua and Waimanalo.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Kaneohe. Pearlridge Center in Aiea runs the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train in Mauka Center Court from November 21, 2026, to January 10, 2027, at $6 per child for children under 48 inches tall. The Hawaiian Railway Society in Ewa Beach runs a Holiday Express Train Ride, a 90-minute nonstop evening ride decorated with hundreds of lights where riders can wear holiday pajamas, according to our museum page on the society.
train_links: Oahu's only operating historic railway, with a Holiday Express Train Ride on restored track.
traditions: The largest community-run parade in the state, with a theme each year.
A Santa arrival day and weeks of photos in Center Court.
A free half-hour of holiday stories at Kaneohe Public Library.
Papahana Kuaola's morning of crafts and Hawaiian Santa songs, now full.
kidfact: Kaneohe's parade is so big that more than 2,400 people march in it.
faq: With the Kaneohe Christmas Parade each December, Santa photos at Windward Mall and a free Santa Claus Story Time at Kaneohe Public Library.
When is the Kaneohe Christmas Parade in 2026?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 9 am, running from Windward Mall to Castle High School.
Is there a free Santa event in Kaneohe?
Yes, Santa Claus Story Time at Kaneohe Public Library on Sunday, November 29, from 2 to 2:30 pm is free.
Where can kids meet Santa in Kaneohe?
At Windward Mall in Center Court through December 24, and at the library's story time on November 29.
Is there a Christmas train ride near Kaneohe?
Not in Kaneohe. Pearlridge Center in Aiea has the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train.

folded.why: Papahana Kuaola's Keiki Kalikimaka (Heeia, Nov 30, $20 per keiki) is on the host site but registration is closed, so it is held. No other verified events.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kaneohe for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 29 (Santa Claus Story Time at Kaneohe Public Library) through December 24 (Photos with Santa at Windward Mall), with the Kaneohe Christmas Parade (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kaneohe

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Kaneohe
  • 2 free events: the Kaneohe Christmas Parade and Santa Claus Story Time at Kaneohe Public Library
  • Meet Santa: Santa Claus Story Time (November 29) and Photos with Santa at Windward Mall (through December 24)
  • Parades: Kaneohe Christmas Parade (December 5, 9 am, Windward Mall to Castle High School)
  • Trains: none in town; the nearest is the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train in Aiea
  • Season: November 29 to December 24
